device.tuner: unknown: the application touches no hardware I2C master in 300 M instructions (nothing to tune without channels); the Globo STB HD N3 runs the same maincode (name 406000000003002) and has a Rafael R820T

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (Libcore 1.1.6, jessie.wei, Fri Jun 15 2012), HDCPKey 0x04FE00, maincode 0x050000 (LZMA), Radioback 0x290000, defaultdb 0x2A0000, userdb 0x2BFF80; the last 4 bytes (5F E3 28 52) are the UART console's CRC, not flash contents

source.author: maciej_333
source.note: Thread "Jak skompilować i uruchomić własny firmware dla ALI M3801 i innych układów z tunerów?", page 1, post #15: attachment "dump.bin" (machine translation: https://www.elektroda.com/rtvforum/topic4156384.html#21794256)

simulator.note: Its LZMA bootloader takes about a minute of emulation; the application draws its first-install wizard (run_dump_maciej_capture_screen.py) and its TM1650 shows " ON " (run_dump_maciej_to_I2C_display_ON.py).

desc: The flash of maciej_333's Opticum STB HD N2, read through the bootloader's UART console ("dump" command), which sends the 4 MB flash followed by a 4-byte CRC -- hence the file's 4194308 bytes.

The attachment "opticum_hd_n2_upgraded.bin" of post #12 in the same thread (the box after the firmware update maciej_333 found on chomikuj.pl, read with a programmer) is byte-identical to the first 4 MB of this file, so it is not kept separately: the update installed the same firmware the box already had.
